description: Create a project to organize documents in your personal or organization workspace. Returns its ID, metadata, instructions, and permissions; omit workspaceId for your account. Does not create documents or invite members. Use create_document with the returned projectId to add a document.

description.description: Project description; omit on updates to retain its current value.

instructions.description: Project instructions for document generation; omit on updates to preserve them.

name.description: Project display name. Required for creation; optional on update.

workspaceId.description: Personal account or organization ID returned by list_workspaces. Omit when optional to use your personal account.

name: create_project
title: Create Project
